combo_label: Keys & Locks × Baking & Cakes × The Wild West

entries.clue: Two-part window that slides, the one a thief tries to lift
Gone off, like milk left out of the fridge; the taste of a long-risen loaf
Panicked mass charge of hooves that flattens everything ahead
Gate fastening with a falling bar lifted by a thumb-piece
Pale and raw in the middle, taken out of the heat far too soon
Canvas-topped cart hauled west by oxen in a rolling train
Hard golden wheat, the grain behind dried pasta
Shadowy figure loitering round a house, who has not broken in — yet
Wyatt, the Arizona lawman whose fame was made after his death
The moving edge of settlement, where the maps ran out
Wafer-thin sheets, buttered and stacked, that bake to a shatter
Reddish scale that grows on iron left in the rain, seizing a gate
Metal screen of bars drawn across a shop front at night
Hard fat from around beef kidneys, sold shredded for dumplings
